mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.role_id, u.email, u.password, u.nickname, u.description, u.last_login_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM user u JOIN root r ON u.id = r.id AND r.type = 'USER' AND ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, u.id
